# 1 Enoch Chapter 67 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** In those days God's word came to me, and he said: "Noah, your case has come before me — a blameless case, a case of love and uprightness.

**2** The angels are right now constructing a wooden vessel. When they finish, I will place my hand on it and protect it. From it the seed of life will go out, and such a transformation will take place that the earth will never again be without inhabitants.

**3** I will establish your descendants before me forever and ever, and I will spread out those who live with you. They will not be fruitless on the face of the earth — they will be blessed and multiply across the earth in the name of the Lord."

**4** He will imprison the angels who practiced unrighteousness in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had once shown me — in the west, among mountains of gold, silver, iron, soft metal, and tin.

**5** I saw that valley: a place of tremendous upheaval, where the very waters were convulsed.

**6** From all this turmoil — from the fiery liquid metal and its agitation in that place — a smell of sulfur rose up. It was connected to those waters. That valley, where the angels who had misled humanity were imprisoned, burned beneath those waters.

**7** Streams of fire run through its valleys, and that is where the angels who led the people of the earth astray are punished.

**8** But in those days those same waters will serve the kings and the powerful and the arrogant and all who rule on earth — healing their bodies while punishing their spirits. For their spirits are consumed by lust, and so they are punished through their bodies. They have denied the Lord of Spirits; they see their punishment happening around them every day, and still they refuse to believe in his name.

**9** And as the burning in their bodies grows more intense, the change in their spirit will correspondingly deepen — forever and ever. For before the Lord of Spirits no one gets to speak an empty word.

**10** The judgment will come upon them because they put their trust in bodily lust and rejected the Spirit of the Lord.

**11** Those same waters will change in those days: when the angels are being punished in these waters, the hot springs will change their temperature; and when the angels are lifted out, the spring will change back and turn cold.

**12** I heard Michael responding and declaring: "This judgment by which the angels are judged is itself a testimony for the kings and the powerful who own the earth.

**13** For these judgment-waters serve to heal the bodies of the kings — and to feed the lust of their bodies. So they will never see, and never believe, that those waters will change and become a fire that burns forever."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Ch. 67 is theologically bold: the same waters that heal the wicked kings' bodies are punishing the angels beneath them. The kings' obliviousness to the source of their healing is the ultimate irony. Michael's commentary turns the hot-spring geography into a judgment parable.*
